authority: single encounter owner with expected-revision persistence

shamanOwner: BindingCompleted with verified native completion and monotonically newer BindingRevision
spellOwner: SpellBroken with verified authored break and explicit positive FrenzyDuration

nonOwners.behemothRuntime: consumes committed state and presentation outputs; retains native movement, attacks, damage, death, drops and corpse
nonOwners.shamanRuntime: produces bind receipts and attempts rebind; does not directly grant allegiance
nonOwners.minionRuntime: reads state to protect shaman; does not mutate allegiance
nonOwners.globalFactionRuntime: used only after an exact-instance lookup returns no override
